offline_mode: If enabled, all online features will be disabled. You will be also able to play with FGTools even if you don't have an internet connection.
offline_username: Username that will be used for offline mode
allow_rpc: If enabled, "Playing FGTools" status will display in your discord profile
use_all_cosmetics: Adds all cosmetics that exist in the CMS to your locker
cosmetics_alert: If enabled, a popup with some info will be shown after equipping cosmetics that you don't have
fc_time_attack_effect: If enabled, all music will have a time attack effect while you're in free camera NOTE: This is no longer functional as mediatonic broke the effect (keeping this only in case they will fix it someday)
watermark_level: If you're disabling the watermark and posting something that was made with FGTools in public, could you mention that this was made via FGTools?
grav_zone_effect: If enabled, all gravity zones will have a muted audio effect
one_time_checkpoint: If enabled, every checkpoint in the game will be set only once
points_goal: Custom amount of points that you need to reach in rounds. If set to 0, the default round amount will be used
airtime_goal: How many percent you need to reach in Airtime to qualify
hide_checkpoint: If enabled, your checkpoint will be invisible
hard_mode: If enabled, you can't set checkpoints and respawn by pressing R
skip_intro: If enabled, the round intro will be instantly skipped
skip_intro_time: The amount of time that you need to hold the "Skip intro" button
round_filter: Round Filter will load a round with specific category (only if it's random loading)
allow_nametags: If enabled, Fall Guy should have an arrow above
object_life_time: How much time a spawned object will be on the scene (in seconds)
time_pause: If the game is paused, every obstacle will stop moving
enable_objective_text: Enables custom text for the objective
random_rings: If enabled, all levels with rings will follow a random limit for rings. If disabled, all possible rings will always be used
custom_camera_distance: Custom distance for camera. If 0 default round value will be used (12-13 in common)
speedrun_old_mode: If enabled, pressing continue in "Speedrun Continue Popup" will make the whole scene reload
random_music: If enabled, music will be selected randomly for every round
old_char_phys: Reverts all Fall Guy physic related changes that Mediatonic made in 10.9.1 update
speedrun_restart_cd: An amount of time in seconds that you need to hold ResetRunHotkey button in order to reset your run
speedrun_points_drop: If enabled, restarting your run will result in points reset too
unknown_1: If enabled, rounds will have random seeds that make variations and some other stuff selects randomly every time
speedrun_insta_start: If enabled, new attempt will instantly start even if you didn't start moving
speedrun_checkpoint_res: If enabled, you will respawn at checkpoint position instead of spawn position
unknown_2: If enabled, rounds checkpoints won't affect you
selected_powerup: What powerup will you have when using round loader (exploding rhino temporary disabled)
powerup_ui: If enabled, Power Up inventory will be visible
inf_powerup: If enabled, you will have infinite uses of Power Up
powerup_amount: Power Up usages, only if "Infinite Usages" is false! (max: 255)
fgc_autosaves: If enabled, your level will autosave at time you selected
fgc_time_between_autosaves: Amount of time that between autosaves
fgc_show_autosave_timer: If enabled, time to autosave will display in left bottom corner of the screen
auto_preset: Automatically sets your last preset when you restarting the game
custom_fonts: If enabled, a custom fonts will be used in FGTools GUI, this might look bad in some specific cases
menu_theme: Theme that used in the Main Menu
disable_checkpoints: A pretty much self explaining thing
fgc_local_saves: If enabled, every autosave will result in creating locally stored level copy that you can always return to
download_mirror: Source that will be used to fetch FGTools content, highly recommended to keep it on "Auto", some sources may have older content version
download_mirror_override: Custom source that will be used for content fetcheing, when set "Download Source" setting will be ignored, keep it blank unless you know what you're doing
speedrun_background_timer: If enabled, speedrun timer will be paused when app is not in focus
fast_load: If enabled rounds loaded via round loader will automatically skip intro and countdown
locker_search_bar: If enabled a search bar will be shown in locker
locker_id_search: If enabled searching will also cover item IDs
locker_item_ids: If enabled an item ID will be shown below it's name in locker
fgt_loading_screen: If enabled Fall Guys loading screens will be replaced with FGTools one
fgt_tips: If enabled a custom round loading screen tips will be shown instead of Fall Guys tips when you're using round loader
